name: Service Requests, RFCs, Device References, Ticket Relationships
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 Customer/Contact/Local User Profile identity, lifecycle, affiliation and matching interfaces

LLD-04 owns immutable published SR/RFC/WFM source observations, proposals, vocabulary and precedence; LLD-03 stores exact immutable cross-packet evidence identities without a physical sequence-3 FK/trigger into sequence-4 private tables and revalidates them through LLD-04 providers inside the owning UnitOfWork
LLD-06 ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant applies classification invalidation consequences inside the caller UnitOfWork
LLD-12 authenticated-browser and deliberate-action proof policies
scope: canonical history-preserving SR Customer relationship and role-specific Contact reference relationships
accepted current Advanced Search SR source projection with exact LLD-04 field evidence
RFC exact identity and accepted current source/lifecycle projection
operational Device Reference identity and SR/RFC links
Working Notes with immutable creator provenance
not_owned_here: Customer Organization/Contact master identity and Contact affiliation -> LLD-02
Advanced Search/RFC/WFM workbook discovery/parsing/staging/immutable source observations, reconciliation proposals and vocabulary -> LLD-04
Product Line/SLA classification/calculation and customer-change classification consequences -> LLD-06
Network Element/Device Reference regularization target -> LLD-08
Communication evidence/links/retention and cascade consequences -> LLD-09
frontend components and deliberate-interaction rendering -> LLD-10
transaction_boundaries: Workbook/source parsing, normalization, reference matching previews and expensive diff work occur outside writer transactions under owning LLDs.
Every standalone LLD-03 authoritative mutation uses one short LLD-01 BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork with idempotency receipt, owned mutation and required audit committed atomically.

LLD-04 accepted SR proposals own the outer receipt/UnitOfWork and invoke LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService without nested commit; exact source/proposal/reference/base-state authority is revalidated inside the same writer transaction.
SR Customer replacement and required LLD-06 classification invalidation are one transaction; participant failure or INDETERMINATE result rolls back both.

SR Contact association revalidates Contact lifecycle/current affiliation, SR Customer context and supporting handler observation under the writer lock; it never writes LLD-02 master identity/affiliation.
Terminal RFC source acceptance and creation/supersession of its pending cascade proposal are one transaction but execute no downstream cascade.
Terminal-cascade execution revalidates exact proposal revision/scope and invokes LLD-05/LLD-09 participants inside the same UnitOfWork; participants never commit independently.
Archive/operation membership/events and RFC archive-state changes are atomic; hard-delete receipt/audit/delete are atomic and unexpected FKs fail closed.
failure_modes: typed domain failures are defined in errors.json and inherit LLD-01 transport/idempotency/stale/persistence failures
stale SR Customer/Contact/handler-source review tokens fail closed and require refreshed exact state
unresolved/ambiguous source Customer/Contact evidence leaves canonical relationships unchanged and does not block independent accepted SR source facts
LLD-06 classification participant failure rolls back an SR Customer change
wrong/unpublished/wrong-family/wrong-SR LLD-04 source evidence cannot become an LLD-03 accepted source observation
stale relationship/cascade/archive/delete previews fail closed and require refreshed exact state
INDETERMINATE cross-domain lifecycle/delete dependencies block destructive or cascade action
terminal source evidence alone never executes the local cascade
crash and participant half-commit behavior is covered by SR-reference and RFC-lifecycle failure-injection tests
review_evidence: Customer/Contact master ownership remains LLD-02 while SR relationship authority remains LLD-03; Advanced Search evidence/proposals remain LLD-04.
Current Handler source text remains sole source-owned assignment authority; resolving it to a Contact never creates a competing local handler fact.
SR Customer changes invoke LLD-06 classification invalidation atomically and never silently select a replacement Customer Product Line.

Accepted SR source-field observations retain exact immutable LLD-04 source_observation_field identities as provider-validated cross-packet evidence references; sequence 3 has no physical FK or trigger into LLD-04 private sequence-4 tables.
RFC current source/lifecycle projection remains separate from immutable source evidence.
Terminal RFC source evidence atomically creates or supersedes a restart-persistent exact-scope cascade proposal but executes no Task/Objective/Communication consequence.
Cascade execution uses same-UoW bounded LLD-05 and LLD-09 participant interfaces with stale and deliberate-confirmation guards.
Direct SR-to-RFC relationship targets the governing root; subordinate RFC cannot become a parent.
Device Reference remains the operational identity before and after later Infrastructure registration.
Working Notes remain SOMA-owned and survive import reconciliation.
Archive/restore provenance is operation-scoped and hard deletion remains limited to provably untouched manual drafts.
V2 retrofit makes every public route machine-addressable with exact request/response contracts, LLD-12 auth policy, stable errors, bounds and audit vocabulary without changing packet semantics.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; the corrected Pass-2 source passed the strengthened whole-repository gate with zero findings.
design_principle: Ticket identity and relationship history survive source adoption, reference correction, hierarchy correction, terminal state, archival and regularization; source labels never become relational identity by themselves, Current Handler remains source-owned assignment authority, current source/lifecycle projections are rebuildable, irreversible evidence remains with its owner, and cross-domain consequences occur only through bounded history-preserving same-transaction interfaces.
